entries.title: 我让 AI 帮我做了一个国际网站
entries.titleEn: I Asked AI to Help Me Build an International Website
entries.excerpt: 不是从完整的方案开始，而是从一个模糊的感觉里，慢慢把网站长出来。
entries.excerptEn: It did not begin with a complete plan. It began with a vague feeling that slowly became a website.

entries.title: 一根软管，一片苔藓，和一朵不会申请专利的云
entries.titleEn: A Tube, a Patch of Moss, and a Cloud Beyond Patents
entries.excerpt: 技术可以被学习，结构可以被复制。但审美，需要一点一点积累。
entries.excerptEn: Technology can be replicated. Structures can be reverse-engineered. Taste cannot.
